newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London down in low volume trade.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London down in low volume trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks slid in low volume London trading on Wednesday, with the blue chip companies feeling the worst of the profit-taking, traders said.
London's Nikkei ISE 50 index fell 34.84 points to 1448.57 by 1554 GMT. In Tokyo,the Nikkei 225 closed down 253.74 points at 20568.38.
"There has been a bit of profit-taking on the blue chips," said one trader. "People do not want to be long," he added.
Another trader said: "Essentially it is a weak market with relatively low volume, and most of the trading has been carried out by professionals."
Traders said the strength of the market would depend greatly on Wall Street. One trader expected the market to open weak tomorrow if Wall Street remains lower than 50 to 60 points down.
